title: Events
subtitle: Create events, open registration and track attendance.

empty.description: Create an event and members will see it in the app once it's published.

delete.title: Delete event?
delete.hasRegistrations: {count, plural, one {# member is} other {# members are}} registered.
delete.hasPaid: This event has paid registrations. Refund them from Payments or unpublish the event instead.

modal.coverHint: Landscape works best (16:9, at least 1600×900). Members see it full-width on the app's home screen.
modal.imageBadType: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
modal.imageTooBig: Image must be 5 MB or smaller.
modal.title: Title
modal.paidHint: Members pay in the app to register; you can also mark payments at the desk.
modal.publishedHint: Visible to the selected members in the app.
modal.draftHint: Hidden from the app until you publish it.
modal.audienceAllHint: Every member of the gym can see and register.
modal.audiencePlansHint: Only members with {count, plural, one {this plan} other {one of these # plans}} can see and register.
modal.optionsHintEmpty: Optional. Add options (e.g. levels) and registrants must pick one.
modal.optionsHint: Registrants must pick exactly one. The order here is the order in the app.
modal.optionsRemoveNote: Removing an option doesn't change existing registrations — they keep the option they chose.
modal.startRequired: Choose a start date and time.
modal.endAfterStart: The end must be after the start.
modal.deadlineBeforeStart: The registration deadline must be before the start.
modal.capacityInvalid: Capacity must be a whole number of 1 or more.
modal.priceInvalid: Paid events need a price of at least 1.00.

roster.title: {title} — roster
roster.emptyHint: Members who register in the app will appear here.
